title: Smiling Mother with Baby in Stroller, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-1960s black-and-white candid photograph featuring a young mother posing outdoors next to her infant in a portable stroller seat. The mother sports a voluminous bouffant hairstyle typical of the era, along with neat makeup and a striped sleeveless dress. The sunny backyard setting reflects mid-century American suburban family life and domestic aesthetics.
